positions.name: ValidFailureReproduction
positions.frame: what does a valid reproduction of a production failure pattern require?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the same diagnostic-craft read: src-1 asserts the reproduction of a specific production failure (missing-id heading), and src-2 sets the correctness constraints that reproduction must satisfy (no crash, valid slug). The tension between the calm factual claim of reproduction and the urgent directive of constraints is held by the frame — the question of what counts as a valid reproduction encompasses both what is reproduced and what it must not do.
